title: PearlBarter
description: 1/20 chance for 4-8 ender pearls with piglin bartering (1.16.1 rates)
body: PearlBarter restores the 1.16.1 piglin bartering rates for ender pearls, giving piglins a 1 in 20 chance to drop 4-8 pearls per gold ingot traded. Drop it in your plugins folder and you're good to go, no config needed.
